title: adp02_tenant_scope_test.zig is orphaned — never imported in tests/integration/main_test.zig
summary: tests/integration/adp02_tenant_scope_test.zig exists with real integration tests TC-ADP-02-01 through TC-ADP-02-05, written using the TestHarness infrastructure and exercising the database. However, the file is never imported in tests/integration/main_test.zig, which is the integration test entry point. As a result, all ADP-02 tenant isolation tests are silently excluded from every 'zig build test-integration' run. The tests are invisible: they do not pass, fail, or appear in any output. All other adp03..adp12 test files are correctly wired.

root_cause.details: The file was likely created by TEST-DESIGNER or BACKEND-DEV but the corresponding @import statement was omitted from main_test.zig when the file was added. The omission went undetected because zig build test-integration exits 0 regardless — there is no mechanism to warn about test files in the integration directory that are not imported.

prevention: After writing any new integration test file, the accepting agent must verify the file appears in 'zig build test-integration' output before marking the handoff COMPLETED.
A CI check that verifies every .zig file under tests/integration/ (excluding main_test.zig itself) is @imported by main_test.zig would prevent this class of error.
